title: [MTR4] Automated Guideway Tracks
description: This resource pack adds automated guideway tracks to Minecraft Transit Railway
body:
This resource pack adds automated guideway tracks to Minecraft Transit Railway 4.x.x. 

To use it, right-click a rail node with a brush and add "Automated Guideway Track" from the list on the left. Remove "Default" from the list on the right.

## Future plans
### v1.1
- Lower repeat interval to prevent glitched appearance on sharp curves

## Support
If you need help using this pack, or if you would like to suggest a feature, ping me (@Kia Granbird Judge) on the MTR Discord server.
